lead_raw_text:
The structure of Zn₂Mg₃F₁₀ crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with a 56-atom unit cell (Zn₈Mg₁₂F₂₀) and five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis shows Mg and Zn centers each surrounded by six F neighbors, while F environments are typically two- or three-coordinate. The periodic neighbor graph is fully connected in three dimensions, and validated polyhedron contacts reveal corner-sharing between Mg- and Zn-centered six-vertex coordination polyhedra, plus corner-sharing between Mg polyhedra.
